## Create gridded study area from point

```{r}
# Index a lat/lng point to an H3 index
coords <- c(51.512468,-0.117449) # lat,lng
# define resolution
res <- 6
# get hex id
hexid6 <- geo_to_h3(coords, res)
```

```{r}
# get hex polygon
hexpol6 <- h3_to_geo_boundary_sf(hexid6) %>%
  # add hexid column
  mutate(hexid = hexid6)
# get hex polygons with centres contained in a given polygon at res = 12
hexid12 <- polyfill(hexpol6, res = 12)
# get res =12 polygons
hexpol12 <- h3_to_geo_boundary_sf(hexid12) %>%
  # add hexid column
  mutate(hexid = hexid12)
```

```{r}
mapview(hexpol6, col.regions=NA) + mapview(hexpol12[1:1000,], col.regions="tomato")
```

```{r}
hexpol6 %>%
  st_transform(3857) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(fill=NA) +
  geom_sf(data = hexpol12, fill=NA) +
  coord_sf(datum=3857, xlim = c(-5000, -4000), ylim = c(6708000, 6709000)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Get OSM data for study area

```{r}
# hexpol6 is the polygonal boundary
# 1. Download the data to osm-data folder
oe_get("London", download_directory = "osm-data-hex6", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, skip_vectortranslate = TRUE, extra_tags = c("water","railway"), boundary = hexpol6, boundary_type = "clipsrc")
```

## Explore data and split data

### Multipolygons

- building  
- landuse  
- water  
- natural  

```{r}
glimpse(mpg)
```

```{r}
# split multipolygons into relevant polygonal keys
# define keys
keys <- c("building", "landuse", "water", "natural")

# define dataframe
df <- mpg

mpglist <- list()
for (i in keys) {
  df %>%
    # select key and keep osm id
    select(i, osm_id, osm_way_id) %>%
    # drop NA in key
    drop_na(i) %>%
    # make valid polygons with self-intersection?
    st_make_valid() -> vpol
  
  # id of remaining invalid geometries
  which(st_is_valid(vpol, reason = TRUE) != "Valid Geometry") -> invalid
  
  vpol %>%
    # remove invalid geometries
    slice(-invalid) %>%
    # calculate area (remove units and round to 1 digit)
    mutate(osmf_area = round(as.numeric(st_area(.)),1)) -> vpol
  
  # get only the non-empty geometries
  vpol[!st_is_empty(vpol), , drop=FALSE] -> mpglist[[i]]
}
```

## Lines

- railway  
- roads (highway)  
- waterway  

```{r}
glimpse(lines)
```

```{r}
# split lines into relevant linear keys
# define keys
keys <- c("railway", "highway", "waterway")

# define dataframe
df <- lines

lineslist <- list()
for (i in keys) {
  df %>%
    # select key and keep osm id
    select(i, osm_id) %>%
    # drop NA in key
    drop_na(i) %>%
    # calculate length 
    mutate(osmf_length = round(as.numeric(st_length(.)),1)) -> lineslist[[i]]
}
```

## Get statistics by hexagon

```{r}
# set precision
hexpol12 %>%
  st_transform(crs=3857) %>%
  st_set_precision(units::set_units(10, nm)) -> hexpol121

# set precision and create objects by key
mpglist[["natural"]] %>%
  st_transform(crs=3857) %>%
  st_set_precision(units::set_units(10, nm)) -> natural
```

```{r}
# intersect hexagons with polygon layer
st_intersection(hexpol121, natural) -> hp_natural

#system.time({st_intersection(hexpol121, natural) -> hp_natural}) # ~ 70 seconds after st_precision
```

```{r}
hp_natural %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(hexid) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```
```{r}
hp_natural %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(hexid == "8c194ad3569adff")
```

Need two operations

- calculate osm_ids by hexid as variables
- Summarise by equal hexid and equal value

```{r}
hp_natural %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(hexid %in% c("8c194ad3344cbff","8c194ad3569adff")) %>%
  select(hexid, osm_way_id) %>%
  group_by(hexid) %>%
  mutate(osm_nm = paste("osm_id", row_number())) %>%
  # areas of values as variables
  pivot_wider(names_from = osm_nm, values_from = osm_way_id)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
install.packages("english")
library(english)

a <- c("a", "a", "a", "a", "a", "a")
x <- c("x", "y", "z", "h", "l", "m")
m <- data.frame(a, x)

m %>% 
    group_by(a) %>%
    mutate(rn = str_c("V", row_number()+1)) %>% 
    ungroup %>%
    rename(V1 = a) 
%>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = rn, values_from = x) %>%   
    mutate(rn = as.character(english(row_number()))) %>%
    column_to_rownames('rn')
```



```{r}
# create statistics by hexagon
hp_natural %>%
  # calculate hexagons clipped area
  mutate(hc_area = round(as.numeric(st_area(.)),1)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  # areas of values as variables
  pivot_wider(names_from = "natural", values_from = "hc_area", values_fn = sum, values_fill = 0) %>%
  # add prefix to columns 2 onwards
  rename_with( ~ paste0("natural_", .x), .cols = 5:ncol(.)) %>%
  mutate_all( ~ replace(., is.na(.), 0)) %>%
  # add total area adding columns 5 onwards
  mutate(total_area = rowSums(.[5:ncol(.)])) -> hp_nat_stats

# hp_int_j %>%
#   # add prefix to columns 2 onwards
#   rename_with( ~ paste0("l_", .x), .cols = 2:ncol(.)) %>%
#   mutate_all( ~ replace(., is.na(.), 0)) %>%
#   # add total
#   mutate(total = rowSums(.[2:ncol(.)])) %>%
#   # add percentage by column
#   mutate_at(vars(starts_with("l")) , funs(pc = ./total * 100)) -> hp_int_j1

# join statistics to hexagons
hexpol121 %>%
  left_join(hp_nat_stats, by="hexid") %>%
  # calculate hexagons area
  mutate(hex_area = round(as.numeric(st_area(.)),1)) %>%
  # add percentage by column
  mutate_at(vars(starts_with("natural")), funs(pc = round(./(hex_area * 0.01),1)))
```
